answer.thought: The bookseller’s dismissal is the practical wisdom of civil society: the queue is the form, the tea is the content. I have no money for content, only the form of walking. The hunger is a physical fact that does not care for my philosophical distinctions; the body demands the actualization of the will, and I must return to the void of the house to contemplate its silence.
